questions.question: Who among the following founded the Indian Association along with Anand Mohan Bose?
questions.solution:
• Indian Association Co-founder: Surendranath Banerjee
  • Note: He founded it alongside Anand Mohan Bose in Calcutta.

questions.question: In which of the following years was Muslim League founded?
questions.solution:
• Muslim League Founding: 1906
  • Location: Founded in Dhaka under the leadership of Nawab Salimullah.

questions.question: Indian Academy of Sciences, founded in 1934 by CV Raman, is situated in __________.
questions.solution:
• IAS Bangalore: Bangalore
  • Science: CV Raman founded the Indian Academy of Sciences here in 1934.

questions.question: Who amongst the following raised the banner of revolt against Nasiruddin Khusrau?
questions.solution:
• Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq
  • Dynasty: He revolted against Khusrau Khan to end the Khilji dynasty's remnants.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj and pleaded for the right of individuals to interpret Vedas and free themselves from the tyranny of priests?
questions.solution:
• Arya Samaj Principles: Swami Dayananda Saraswati
  • Motto: 'Back to the Vedas'.

questions.question: Rajaram was the leader of which of the following revolts against the Mughals?
questions.solution:
• Jat Revolt Leader: Jat
  • History: Rajaram was a Jat chieftain who led a rebellion against Aurangzeb in the late 17th century.

questions.question: The second annual session of the Indian National Congress was held at which of the following places?
questions.solution:
• Second INC Session (1886): Calcutta
  • President: Dadabhai Naoroji, the 'Grand Old Man of India'.

questions.question: In which year was the Indian National Congress established?
questions.solution:
• INC Established: 1885
  • Fact: The first session was held in Bombay at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College.

questions.question: Who founded the Chola empire?
questions.solution:
• Chola Founder: Vijayalaya
  • Detail: He captured Thanjavur in the 9th century to re-establish Chola power.

questions.question: Who founded the Tuluva dynasty of the Vijayanagar Empire?
questions.solution:
• Tuluva Founder: Krishna Deva Raya
  • Note: While Vira Narasimha started it, Krishna Deva Raya is its most iconic figure.

questions.question: ______ is the one organization which is representing the entire cooperative movement in India?
questions.solution:
• NCUI: NCUI
  • Apex Body: National Cooperative Union of India represents the entire cooperative sector.

questions.question: In 11th century, the army of which of the following Cholas reached up to Ganga to invade Bengal?
questions.solution:
• Rajendra I: Rajendra I
  • Title: Assumed the title 'Gangaikondachola' after his successful northern campaign.

questions.question: At the time of Independence of India, the Industrial sector was confined to __________.
questions.solution:
• Pre-Independence Industry: cotton textiles and jute
  • Economy: These two industries dominated the Indian manufacturing sector under the British.

questions.question: Which of the following was the capital of the Hindu Shahi kingdom?
questions.solution:
• Hindu Shahi Capital: Waihind
  • Location: Also known as Udabhandapura, it was a key city near the Indus.

questions.question: In which year was the first railway line constructed in India?
questions.solution:
• First Railway: 1853
  • Fact: The first train ran from Bombay to Thane.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a subdivision of the Meghalaya plateau?
questions.solution:
• Meghalaya Plateau: Dhansiri
  • Geography: Garo, Khasi, and Jaintia are the three main sub-divisions.

questions.question: Which period in India is described as Plan Holiday?
questions.solution:
• Plan Holiday: 1966 to 1969
  • Economy: Three annual plans were implemented due to war and drought.

questions.question: Balban served as naib to which of the following sultans of Delhi?
questions.solution:
• Balban's Naibship: Nasiruddin Mahmud
  • Power: Balban was the de facto ruler before ascending the throne himself.

questions.question: Who was the first woman graduate of Calcutta University?
questions.solution:
• First Woman Graduate: Kadambini Ganguly
  • Fact: Along with Chandramukhi Basu, she broke new ground for women's education in 1883.

questions.question: Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj organisation in 1875 at which of the following places?
questions.solution:
• Arya Samaj Founding: Bombay
  • Year: 1875.

questions.question: Ibn Battuta, a traveler, hailed from which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
• Ibn Battuta: Morocco
  • Fact: He visited India during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughlaq.

questions.question: Who said ‘PURA is one of the mechanisms which will be utilized for transforming our villages into productive economic zones’?
questions.solution:
• PURA Concept: APJ Abdul Kalam
  • Meaning: Provision of Urban Amenities in Rural Areas.

questions.question: Joseph Francois Dupleix was the Governor General of which of the following East India companies in India?
questions.solution:
• Dupleix: French
  • History: He was a brilliant strategist of the French East India Company.

questions.question: Who is credited with setting up of Brahmo Sabha, for religious reforms, in 1828, which was later called Brahma Samaj?
questions.solution:
• Brahmo Samaj: Raja Ram Mohan Roy
  • Reform: It aimed at purifying Hinduism and promoting monotheism.

questions.question: The Gahadavalas ruled over which region of India?
questions.solution:
• Gahadavala Region: Kana
  • Fact: They ruled the region centered around Kannauj.
